facets.description: isAccessTokenId (AssertEvents.java line 483) has the grant-shortcut check inverted: it returns false when the shortcut matches expectedGrantShortcut, so valid IDs are rejected and wrong grants can pass
isAccessTokenId reads the grant shortcut with substring(3,5); the shortcut is actually at indices 4..6 (2-char session + 2-char token type + 2-char grant)
